messages.subject: Re: Cant get RRO to work in RStudio
parts:
Hi, Karin

Thank you for trying RRO.

Unfortunately the functions you ask about are part of Revolution R Enterprise (RRE), and are not included in RRO.

If you want to benefit from the additional scalability and performance built into RRE, then take a look at http://www.revolutionanalytics.com/revolution-r-enterprise

Regards

Andrie
